algorithm: Filter tropes by subgenre, then pick one per role (hero, conflict, world, theme). Each pick is weighted random with weight = w. Every w is 1, so all tropes are equally likely; raise a trope's w to make it come up more.

tropes.d: Nobody special, until the prophecy turned out to mean them.
Raised in hiding, rightful ruler of a throne someone else is sitting on.
Fights for pay, but there are jobs no amount of gold will buy.
Knows just enough magic to get into serious trouble.
Hung up the sword for a quiet life; the quiet life didn't take.
Sworn to a holy order, and about to find out what that oath costs.
Takes the cases the police won't write down.
Their contraptions mostly work, and occasionally change the world.
An ordinary person from here, out of their depth over there.
Herbs, poultices, and quiet competence that the great and powerful underestimate.
Knows the wild roads and the things that walk them.
Rides out to right wrongs, one village at a time.
Runs a little shop where the customers are stranger than the stock.
Keeps the things in the dark from coming out of it.
The elder two failed the quest; the kind one gets their turn.
An old evil has returned, and the old defenses have been forgotten.
Find the one thing that can turn the tide before the enemy does.
The rightful line was overthrown, and the land is suffering for it.
Break into a sorcerer's stronghold to take back what was stolen.
The hidden world is leaking into the ordinary one.
Something was bound long ago, and the terms of release are a riddle.
A great beast has come, and the town must answer it.
Two orders of craft or magic, one charter, and no room for both.
The door closed behind them, and the only way back runs through the danger.
The walls must hold until the relief comes, if it comes.
Someone made a deal with a clever spirit, and the fine print is coming due.
The beloved place is about to be lost unless the community rallies.
Everyone acted on the prophecy, and everyone got it wrong.
The factories are rising, and the old magic is dying in their smoke.
Get someone precious from here to there, with something hunting the road between.
The old glory is fading, and the provinces are restless.
Every road passes through it, and so does every story.
Where the paths move and the trees remember.
Lessons, rivals, rules, and a forbidden wing.
Brass, steam, and spellwork, with fog in the gaslit lanes.
A magical neighborhood folded inside a modern city.
Buried cities, old treasure, and whatever guards it.
A whole world behind the back of a wardrobe, a well, or a painting.
Halls carved deep into the mountain, with older things deeper still.
An island from the old songs, and it is real.
Every ship brings trouble, and every alley sells it.

tropes.n: Village at the Edge of the Wild
tropes.d: Snug homes, a good harvest, and something stirring past the hedge.
Ceremony on the surface, rivalry underneath.
Islands adrift in an endless sky, linked by bridges and winds.
A reflected realm where everything familiar is turned just slightly wrong.
A night market for the hidden folk, open only to those who know the way in.
There is a right side, and it is worth standing on.
The ring, the crown, the spell: what the wish to rule does to people.
Ordinary folk do the deeds that turn the wheels of the world.
Strangers who choose to belong to each other.
What it is, why we leave it, and what it takes to return.
Victory costs someone something they can't get back.
The hero has every right to strike, and chooses not to.
The world is stranger and lovelier than we thought.
What is worth keeping when everything changes.
A sworn word binds, even when it hurts.
The wonder is leaving the world; someone must tend what remains.
A past wrong, owned and paid for.
